## Review checklist

The reviewer checks each box before merging. AI-written PRs get the same review as any other.

- [ ] I read every changed line and can explain why it changed.
- [ ] The title names the issue it closes ("Closes #N").
- [ ] New behavior has tests, and CI is green.
- [ ] No secrets, real keys, or personal data are added.
- [ ] README and docs match the new behavior.
